item.title: Gamification fails when it turns into surveillance or burnout
item.description: The test is operational: after one concrete change to teams launch mechanics quickly, but capability still stalls because motivation and recovery loops in real work are underdesigned, teams should be able to point to a sharper next decision, cleaner execution, or a more reliable handoff.

item.title: Why delight belongs inside the core loop
item.description: The test is operational: after one concrete change to teams ship functional experiences, but users still feel friction, guilt, or indifference because emotional design is treated as an extra, teams should be able to point to a sharper next decision, cleaner execution, or a more reliable handoff.
